We create compelling experiences that connect people with wildlife and inspire personal responsibility for conserving the natural world.

As the Zoo’s nonprofit advocate and partner, the Cleveland Zoological Society is committed to: 1) raising awareness of the Zoo as a community priority 2) improving all aspects of the Zoo, from exhibits to programs to daily operations and 3) giving visitors, members and donors great value for their investment

Founded in 1957, the Zoo Society strives to ensure that Cleveland Metroparks Zoo remains one of the region’s preeminent destinations.
